description: Check the company tracking domain's CNAME and HTTPS certificate now instead of waiting for the automatic check. Returns verified, a message with the next step, and the tracking domain status.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: verify_tracking_domain

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `verify_tracking_domain` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

trackingDomain.description: Company tracking domain {domain, status, active, everVerified, sslStatus, verifiedAt, lastCheckedAt, error, cnameRecord} after the check.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

verified.description: Whether the tracking domain's CNAME and HTTPS certificate are working.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
